description:
Reflection: inspect and change any object's properties and call its Blueprint-callable functions, like Epic's object
tools. Targets are node ids, actor:Name, components ("n12#LightComponent0", from actors.list_components), shortcuts
(pawn, game_mode, world_settings...), subsystem:<kind>/<Class> or object paths; project policy can deny classes.
Workflow: list_properties (types, enum values) -> get_properties -> set_properties (one undo step) or reset_properties;
describe_enum for enum names; list_functions -> call_function for behaviour; find_class to discover classes.
name: reflection

tools.description:
Calls a BlueprintCallable function with named arguments. Missing arguments use zero/default values (listed in defaulted); a WorldContextObject argument is filled in. Fails for unknown functions, unknown argument names, latent functions and functions denied by project settings.
Returns: Return value, out parameters, defaulted parameter names and whether the call was side-effect free.
This cannot be undone: only call it after explicit direction or permission from the user.

args.description: Arguments by parameter name, e.g. {"NewLocation": [0, 0, 100]}. (Any JSON value)

target.description: Object, or class:/Script/Module.Class for static library functions. (Reference to Object: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: reflection.call_function

returnValue.description: Return value, out parameters, defaulted parameter names and whether the call was side-effect free.

defaulted.description: Parameters that were not passed and used their zero/default value.

outputs.description: Out parameters by name. (Any JSON value)

return.description: Return value (null for functions without one). (Any JSON value)

undoable.description: False when the function may have changed state (only pure/const functions are side-effect free).

returnValue.title: RuntimeCallResult

tools.description:
Describes an enum: its value names (what enum properties and arguments accept) and numbers. Fails if no loaded enum has that name; similar names are suggested.
Returns: Name, path, whether it is a bit-flag enum, and its values in declaration order.

enum.description: Enum name or path, e.g. "ECollisionChannel", "EComponentMobility" or "/Script/Engine.ELightUnits".

tools.name: reflection.describe_enum

returnValue.description: Name, path, whether it is a bit-flag enum, and its values in declaration order.

values.description: Values in declaration order (hidden and _MAX entries left out).

name.description: Name to pass as a value, e.g. "Movable".

returnValue.title: RuntimeEnumInfo

tools.description:
Finds loaded classes by name, optionally derived from a base class (Epic: search_subclasses). Fails if the base class does not exist.
Returns: Total count and classes {name, path, parent, abstract}.
tools.name: reflection.find_class

returnValue.description: Total count and classes {name, path, parent, abstract}.

path.description: Full path, e.g. "/Script/Engine.PointLight" (pass it to actors.spawn_actor class).

returnValue.title: RuntimeClassList

tools.description:
Reads several properties at once (Epic: get_properties).
Returns: Path -> value. Fails on the first unknown path.

target.description: Object to read. (Reference to Object: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: reflection.get_properties

returnValue.description: Path -> value. Fails on the first unknown path.

tools.description:
Reads one property by path. Fails if the path does not exist (see list_properties).
Returns: The path, the property type and the value.

target.description: Object to read. (Reference to Object: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: reflection.get_property

returnValue.description: The path, the property type and the value.

path.description: The property path that was read.

value.description: Value as JSON: numbers, strings, [x,y,z] vectors, [r,g,b,a] colors, objects for structs, references for objects. (Any JSON value)

returnValue.title: RuntimePropertyValue

tools.description:
Gets a subsystem as a target string for the other reflection tools. Fails if the class does not exist or the subsystem is not running.
Returns: The target string, class path and number of callable functions.
tools.name: reflection.get_subsystem

returnValue.description: The target string, class path and number of callable functions.

callable_functions.description: Number of functions call_function may call.

target.description: Target string for other reflection tools, e.g. "subsystem:world/MySubsystem".

returnValue.title: RuntimeSubsystemInfo

tools.description:
Lists the functions call_function may call on an object, with signatures.
Returns: Class, total count and signatures.

target.description: Object to inspect. (Reference to Object: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: reflection.list_functions

functions.description: Signatures "Name(type Param, out type Param) -> type", at most `limit`.

tools.description:
Lists an object's properties with their types, enum values and (optionally) current values.
Returns: Class, total count and properties {name, type, read_only, enum_values, value, value_preview}.

include_values.description: Include current values (long values become a 200-character preview).

target.description: Object, e.g. "n12", "n12#PointLightComponent0" or "world_settings". (Reference to Object: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: reflection.list_properties

returnValue.description: Class, total count and properties {name, type, read_only, enum_values, value, value_preview}.

properties.description: Properties in declaration order (subclass first), at most `limit`.

enum_values.description: Allowed values for enum properties (pass one of these names).

name.description: Property name, usable as a path segment ("Intensity", "RelativeLocation").

value.description: Current value (with include_values; null when the value was too long, see value_preview). (Any JSON value)

value_preview.description: First 200 characters of a long value (with include_values).

total.description: Number of matching properties (may exceed the list).

returnValue.title: RuntimePropertyList

tools.description:
Resets properties to their defaults (the object's archetype: class defaults, or the Blueprint/component template), as one undo step (Epic: reset_properties). Fails if a path is unknown or read-only.
Returns: Path -> value after the reset.

target.description: Object to change. (Reference to Object: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: reflection.reset_properties

tools.description:
Writes several properties as one undo step (Epic: set_properties). All paths are checked first; nothing changes if any path is unknown or read-only.
Returns: Path -> value read back after the change.

target.description: Object to change. (Reference to Object: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: reflection.set_properties

returnValue.description: Path -> value read back after the change.

tools.description:
Writes one property by path. Undoable. Vectors as [x,y,z], colors as [r,g,b,a], enums by name, objects by reference. Fails if the path does not exist or the property is read-only (try a setter with call_function).
Returns: The target, the path and the value read back.

target.description: Object to change. (Reference to Object: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: reflection.set_property

returnValue.description: The target, the path and the value read back.

value.description: Value after the change (read back). (Any JSON value)

returnValue.title: RuntimePropertyChange
